# What is cold brew?

Cold brew is coffee steeped in cold water for many hours.

## What is cold brew?

It is coffee made without heat.

## How long should it steep?

Twelve to eighteen hours in the fridge works for most beans.

## does grind size matter

Yes: a coarse grind keeps the brew from turning muddy.

## WHAT IS COLD BREW?

The same question again, in capitals.

## How to filter it

Pour it through a paper filter.
